systems.country_label: national register and district registers; population register of births, marriages and deaths
systems.tiers: registers recorded at village, traditional authority, district and national levels; every District Commissioner or Chief Executive is the district registrar, keeps the district registers and forwards applications and monthly returns to the Director; the Act describes books, forms and returns and no electronic system

note: A statute (published 14 January 2010): it makes the District Commissioner or Chief Executive the district registrar and lets reports be delivered to local authority staff, but states nothing about any council office's connection; a law places nothing.
